requirements.requirement: Departure full-body lateral position relative to entered highway centerline after turn
requirements.source: NRS 484B.400(2)(b); After entering the intersection, the left turn must be made so as to leave the intersection to the right of the centerline of the highway being entered.

requirements.requirement: Both intersecting highways two-directional and public intersection context
requirements.source: Construct both highways as undivided with permitted opposite-direction travel; establish public-highway status and qualifying non-alley intersection boundaries.
